answer: Unclonable chip custody binding: each identity must answer a fresh challenge from a distinct unclonable chip, and the vault records one fingerprint per identity, so copied keys cannot create another. A mandatory real-time delay before response stops bulk precomputation; a nebula of cloned agents still needs one physical chip and handling per identity. An attacker pays chip purchase, custody, and the wait at the wharf where credentials are issued, not just compute.
